values.value: Re-engage on expired renewal quote for {accountName}

1. Open the expired Quote (Id {primaryRecordId}) for account {accountName} ({accountId}). 2. Quote expired {daysExpired} days ago on {expirationDate}; ARR at risk: {arrAtRisk}. 3. Decide: clone + re-quote with current pricing, or close the opportunity if the customer churned. 4. If churned, mark the related Opportunity as Closed Lost and route to retention. 5. Verify a follow-up Task exists on the Account so the renewal motion doesn't slip again.
Customer churned; closing related Opportunity as Closed Lost.
CSM has re-engaged; renewal motion restarted.
Forecasted to close next quarter; tracking on account plan.
